subject: Re: Privacy evidence and DPIA support — Northstar Bank onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Marin <elena.marin@northstarbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Privacy evidence / DPIA questions for onboarding
Cc: security@northstarbank.com

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of Northstar Bank's vendor onboarding and our DPIA scoping we need a short set of deliverables to satisfy our internal audit and privacy team before we go to procurement. Can you provide the following items or confirm when they will be available?

- Completed DPIA questionnaire (attached template) with answers for processing categories and risk mitigations.
- A redacted Art. 30 processing activities register or export of the processing ledger that links subprocessors and transfer destinations.
- Confirmation of subprocessor list and the timeline for any planned subprocessor changes (incl. planned cloud regions).
- Evidence of contractual audit rights and the DPA (including the proposed addendum).
- A contact for security-led evidence review and a proposed 2-hour window for an evidence walkthrough (ideally next week).

We've attached our template (Northstar_DPIA_Questions.xlsx) to help with formatting. If Redwood has a standard evidence packet or a read-only audit ledger link, that will speed things up.

We treat this as a routine onboarding step but we do need the items above inside two weeks to keep our timeline.

Best,
Elena Marin
Data Protection Officer
Northstar Bank
elena.marin@northstarbank.com

Attachment: Northstar_DPIA_Questions.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Marin <elena.marin@northstarbank.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy evidence / DPIA questions for onboarding

Hi Elena — thanks, and great to meet you over email.

Appreciate the clear list. High-level plan and who owns each item:

- DPIA questionnaire: marissa will populate answers for the processing and mitigations sections and return a first draft by EOD 3/05. (owner: marissa_c)
- Art. 30 / processing ledger export: we can provide an extract and a redacted CSV showing subprocessors + transfer countries. I expect delivery 3/05-3/06. (owner: platform-ops)
- Subprocessor list & roadmap: marissa will attach the current inventory and a short note on planned changes; we will call out any planned region additions.
- Contractual evidence / DPA addendum: laura (legal) will attach the DPA and proposed addendum template and confirm audit rights scope.
- Evidence walkthrough: happy to host a 60–90 min session. I can offer Wed 3/10 10:00–11:30 PT or Thu 3/11 16:00–17:30 PT — let me know which works.

I'll start a consolidated evidence packet and share a read-only Drive link once laura confirms the DPA bits.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-04T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy evidence / DPIA questions for onboarding

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick status and what we'll provide by 3/05:

1) DPA and audit rights: attached is the standard DPA plus a proposed addendum specific to Northstar (DPA_Addendum_Northstar_2027.pdf). The addendum includes:
   - scoped audit rights (remote evidence review + one on-site right with 30 days notice)
   - permitted audit activities and data minimization steps
   - redaction and pseudonymization clauses for shared artifacts

2) Art. 30 / Processing register: we will export the processing ledger slice for the services Northstar intends to use, redacting tenant identifiers and presenting the mapping to subprocessors and transfer jurisdictions.

3) Evidence pack: Marissa will assemble a read-only Drive folder (links below) that contains:
   - encryption & KMS architecture overview
   - sample audit logs (access-only, redacted)
   - SOC-related attestations and controls mapping (summary doc)

Action items:
- Marissa: assemble the Drive folder and populate DPIA answers (target 2027-03-05 17:00 PT)
- Ben: confirm preferred walkthrough time with Elena and invite security@northstarbank.com
- Laura: finalize DPA addendum and attach to the evidence packet (in progress)

Drive (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-example-evidence-pack
Docusign room (DPA): https://app.docusign.com/rooms/12345-Northstar-DPA

I'll flag any items that require legal redaction before we share.

—Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: DPA_Addendum_Northstar_2027.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Marin <elena.marin@northstarbank.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, security@northstarbank.com
Date: 2027-03-05T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy evidence / DPIA questions for onboarding

Elena — we put together the initial packet and can run the walkthrough on Wed 3/10 10:00–11:30 PT. Please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite with a read-only Drive link and the evidence packet attached.

Contents included in the packet (Evidence_Packet_v1.zip attached):
- Completed DPIA answers (DPIA_answers_Marissa_v1.docx)
- Redacted processing ledger (processing_ledger_export_redacted.csv)
- Current subprocessor inventory (subprocessor_inventory_202703.csv)
- DPA + proposed addendum (attached separately)
- KMS & encryption overview, sample access logs (redacted)

If you need any specific artifact (e.g., full audit logs or raw ledger extracts) ahead of time, note that we'll need to coordinate a protected upload and a short NDAs amendment; otherwise the redacted artifacts should cover most review needs.

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.

Ben

Attachment: Evidence_Packet_v1.zip (zip)
